jobs.excerpt: What Clarity isClarity RCM handles revenue cycle management for independent dermatology practices: billing, claims, collections, the whole back end that determines whether a practice actually gets paid for the work it does.
jobs.description:
What Clarity is

Clarity RCM handles revenue cycle management for independent dermatology practices: billing, claims, collections, the whole back end that determines whether a practice actually gets paid for the work it does. We serve 200+ practices in 44 states and manage over $1B in annual collections. Inc. 5000 listed, up roughly 500% over two years. We are bootstrapped and profitable.

What the role is

Clarity currently has no sales team. All business had been inbound and the founder and CEO has personally handled every inbound call, quote and contract. This is the first hire against that problem. The role starts by taking on the front end of the sales process and grows into a fully additive seat. Initially, there is no cold calling or list of strangers to dial. Over time, this role will be a combination of inbound and outbound sales.

What you'll do

  • Work the inbound flow. Practices come to Clarity because something in their billing is broken. You qualify, understand what is actually happening inside that practice, and move them forward.
  • Work the backlog: closed-lost deals worth revisiting, half-completed forms, website visitors who never booked, conversations where the timing was wrong and may not be anymore. There is real revenue sitting in this pile that nobody has had time to touch.
  • Work referrals through the account management team. Our AMs speak with satisfied clients daily. No one has systematically asked those clients who else they know.
  • Own your deals end to end, from first call to signed contract. Know when to pull in the right resources, and proactively seek support when it will help move a deal forward.

Who you are

  • You have 2-3 years of work experience with medical practices. This might be as an BDR or office manager, practice manager or strong EA working in dermatology, or something adjacent: aesthetics, med spa, cosmetic dentistry, DSO/MSO, practice management, or medical billing.
  • You are ruthlessly organized. This is the non-negotiable. The job is a pipeline, and pipelines fail when someone forgets the follow-up on day 9.
  • You are competitive. You keep score. You look at your own numbers and think about what you would do differently.
  • You are persistent and find satisfaction in running the same loop better each time. You will get ghosted. You will hear the same three objections repeatedly. You will send the same follow-up for the fourth time.
  • You're customer obsessed. What we do is extremely important. You will do whatever it takes to ensure our clients are taken care of, even after the sale.

What we offer

Fully remote, US-based. Competitive salary plus on target earnings (OTE) and benefits. Bay Area not required.

Direct work with the founder, daily. This role exists to take work off his desk, which means you learn the business from the inside faster than you would in a company with three layers between you and the decisions.

jobs.excerpt: About Gruntwork:Gruntwork is on a mission to transform the way DevOps is done.
jobs.description:
About Gruntwork:

Gruntwork is on a mission to transform the way DevOps is done. Let’s face it: designing, launching, and managing infrastructure is still a terrible experience for most organizations, but it doesn’t have to be that way!

We are globally recognized both for our open source tools used by thousands of companies from startups to Fortune 500s, and our thought leadership on how DevOps should be done.

About this role:

Gruntwork is hiring a senior Golang engineer to focus specifically on Open Source projects, primarily OpenTofu but also other open source tools at Gruntwork.

  • Work collaboratively with the open source community to design and implement innovative new features at the frontier of DevOps tooling

  • Help maintain and improve the quality of our codebases, infrastructure, and documentation

  • Review and provide feedback on pull requests from the community and team members

This is a contractor position, paid based on an hourly rate. We expect an average of 25-35 hours of work per week up to 35 hours (based on your availability and skill level) however, you have the ability to control when you work (assuming you coordinate this with your colleagues on the OpenTofu development team).

Although you would start as a contractor, this role sets up a path to full-time employment with Gruntwork when future positions open up, if that’s of interest to you.

Qualifications for Success:

  • 5+ years of experience in software development, with a focus on Golang

  • Proven experience with open source projects, ideally in a leadership role

  • Must have strong communication skills in English, both written and verbal, and are comfortable engaging with external members of the open source community as well as Gruntwork customers

  • You're interested in working a flexible number of hours that averages ~25-35
    hours/week and are available ~48 weeks per year to work those hours

  • You have read our company values, and are aligned with them

About you:

We’re looking for a Grunt who:

  • Loves making customers happy. You're on a mission to making customers happy and successful. You're eager to leverage your talents to meet their needs.

  • Loves to learn. You're excited to learn new skills, and looking to be at the forefront of Engineering and DevOps best practices.

  • Loves a challenge. You like to perform at your best by aiming high while also taking care of yourself and those around you.

  • Cares about your fellow humans. You look to make personal connections with the people you work with, and you want to work for a company whose mission and people you believe in.

  • Has extensive experience with building infrastructure. You have worked for years with cloud technologies, have deep familiarity with building cloud infrastructure and security best practices.

  • Has extensive OpenTofu/Terraform experience. You have directly authored plenty of OpenTofu/Terraform modules, you've operated OpenTofu/Terraform in prod and can speak from your years of experience, and you're excited to use and improve OpenTofu.

  • Has a passion for DevOps best practices. You're passionate about the best way to run modern cloud infrastructure in a secure, convenient, and enjoyable way.

  • Has experience taking ownership of software. You can work with stakeholders to define features, plan work, and ship according to plan.

  • Is productive. You can continuously improve a massive project depended on by thousands of engineers safely.

  • Is good at asynchronous collaboration. You are comfortable working with a team of remote engineers, and are able to break down problems and solutions so that they can be addressed in highly visible, manageable chunks of work.

  • Is good at testing well. You know how to balance speed and coverage in the tests you write, and you design software with testability in mind.

  • Is good at using AI well. You understand the complexities of how and when AI-assisted tooling should be used in the development process. You are comfortable using AI (e.g. using Claude, Codex, Cursor, Copilot, etc.) to investigate, generate and troubleshoot code. The OpenTofu project specifically does not allow AI usage at the moment, but will likely allow for limited AI usage through GitHub Copilot in the near future.

About your time zone:

One of our values is that work-life balance leads to both better work and a better life, so we require that all our team members live in a time zone between Los Angeles and New York, inclusive. You can be located anywhere in the western hemisphere, though most of our team is in the USA and Canada.

Our interview process:

After you apply for this role, here's the process we'll go through to evaluate a mutual fit. As this role is closely linked with the OpenTofu community project, the OpenTofu core development team will be involved in the technical phases of this interview process.

  1. Phone screen. We'll do a quick phone screen to assess a general fit. We’ll also ask for references we can follow-up with to learn more about you.

  2. Values screen. We’ll do a quick phone call to assess alignment with Gruntwork values.

  3. Technical interview. We'll talk shop with you to see if we're on the same page about the technical requirements for the role.

  4. OpenTofu technical interview. A deeper technical interview driven by the OpenTofu development team, specifically as it pertains to OpenTofu development.

  5. Trial Day. A paid day of work with the OpenTofu team doing the same work you’re expected to perform day-to-day.

  6. Offer! We're very pleased to be working together!

jobs.title: Senior Data Scientist Job
jobs.excerpt: Who We Are At Murmuration, we believe that America’s promise is shaped and reshaped by the best ideas and ideals of its communities, and the dreams of the people who believe in a better life for themselves, their families, and each other.
jobs.description:
Who We Are
At Murmuration, we believe that America’s promise is shaped and reshaped by the best ideas and ideals of its communities, and the dreams of the people who believe in a better life for themselves, their families, and each other.

We help organizations build power in their communities in four key ways: we organize a network of values-aligned partners; we provide deep, data-driven insights into people, places, and perspectives; we develop tools that make organizing and engagement easy and more effective; and we offer services that strengthen our partners’ capacity to lead change in their communities.

We envision an America where every community has what it needs to help people lead healthy, free, and dignified lives. We work to redesign the systems and structures we all depend on — how we learn, live, govern, and solve problems — so that they are just, equitable, resilient, and rooted in shared responsibility. By strengthening the ties that hold communities together, we aim for civic life defined by collective action and care, with effective leadership that truly represents everyone.

We are a collaborative, curious, and creative team of organizers, scientists, teachers, technologists, campaign veterans, and more who share the unwavering belief that we can use our gifts in service of transforming America — together. We’ve built our team guided by the belief that the whole is greater than the sum of its parts. And so we support each other relentlessly — rallying together to face challenges the same way we celebrate each other’s wins.

About the Position

As a Senior Data Scientist at Murmuration, you’ll practice “full-stack” data science, shepherding problems from ideation to implementation. The Data Science team works on diverse datasets with hundreds of millions of records to analyze data, build pipelines, and derive insights to power Murmuration’s data and tools. A core part of this work is our predictive stack: we use the voter file and other supplemental datasets to build scores that predict individual behaviors and beliefs, such as likelihood to turn out to vote, support an issue, or volunteer on a campaign. These scores help campaigns and organizers allocate their resources more effectively, reaching the right people at the right time. In this role, you will help drive this work forward, developing innovative methodologies with a focus on campaign data models and entity resolution. As a senior member of the team, you’ll mentor developing data scientists and junior analysts and collaborate closely with the engineering, product, and research teams.

Job Level P4

What You’ll Do

  • Lead and execute data science projects, including predictive modeling, algorithm design, and data pipelines;
  • Develop innovative, industry-leading campaign data science models, specifically partisanship and turnout models;
  • Independently (and often collaboratively) explore data sets for insights and understanding what can help drive product development and feature prioritization;
  • Transform data into actionable and compelling insights through analysis and visualization, and then effectively communicate these data-driven stories to internal and external stakeholders through memos and presentations;
  • Collaborate with the Engineering Team to take data science products and concepts into production;
  • Provide guidance and mentoring to level-up junior data scientists in both formal and informal learning sessions; and
  • Apply emerging AI technologies to R&D challenges; you’ll prototype novel approaches, evaluate feasibility, and bridge the gap between cutting-edge capabilities and practical usability.

Requirements

  • 6+ years of work experience as a Data Scientist or equivalent role producing models and analytics for business applications;
  • Deep understanding of advanced data science techniques, machine learning algorithms, and optimization methods;
  • Experience building and deploying machine learning models;
  • Proficiency in data engineering and data pipelines;
  • Skill in using advanced data visualization tools and techniques to effectively communicate insights and tell compelling stories with data;
  • Mastery of programming languages (Python and SQL), version control (Git), and ability to learn and apply new data science tools and techniques efficiently;
  • Exceptional problem-solving abilities, strong leadership skills, and ability to communicate insights strategically to influence team direction;
  • Ability to mentor and guide junior team members in their technical growth and development; and
  • Capacity to work collaboratively with cross-functional teams and stakeholders.

Nice to Haves

  • Domain expertise in organizing and advocacy;
  • Experience working with voter file data and in campaign data science;
  • Familiarity with data engineering tools such as dbt and Dagster;
  • Experience with polling methodologies, survey analysis, and multilevel regression and poststratification (MRP) modeling; and/or
  • Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Statistics, Computer Science, Mathematics, Physics, Economics, Computer Engineering, or a related field.

Talented Data Scientists come from all walks of life and career. If you are passionate about civic engagement and technology, please apply, even if you do not check every box!

Benefits

Location and Compensation

The Senior Data Scientist is a full-time, salaried position with a comprehensive benefits package (detail below), open to candidates anywhere in the United States.

The starting salary for this position is $183,013. We set compensation using market data and apply it consistently across the organization to ensure fairness and transparency for everyone in similar roles.

Our Culture of Care

We work hard to create a culture of care to ensure that our staff are best equipped to lead happy, healthy, and balanced lives. To that end, we offer a comprehensive benefits package which includes:

  • Health, vision, and dental insurance with 100% of premiums covered for you and qualifying family members;
  • Retirement benefits with a 5% employer match;
  • A flexible unlimited PTO plan;
  • Generous paid parental leave;
  • Pre-tax commuter benefits;
  • A company laptop;
  • A flexible remote work environment;
  • A home office setup stipend for all new employees;
  • Monthly reimbursement for remote work expenses;
  • A yearly professional development fund;
  • Mental health and wellness benefits through Calm and Better Help;
  • Yearly in-person staff retreats; and
  • A welcoming culture that celebrates diversity, equity, inclusion, and belonging.

At Murmuration, we believe a vibrant, representative democracy depends on the inclusion of diverse voices, lived experiences, and perspectives. The best ideas don’t come from a single person or ideology — they emerge at the intersection of different backgrounds, identities, and viewpoints. We are proud of our commitment to building an organization and culture shaped by respect, empathy, and collaboration, where our team’s diversity fuels innovation, civic engagement, and meaningful change. We welcome new colleagues who will help us nurture this collective effort. Join us.

An Equal-Opportunity Employer with a Commitment to Diversity

Murmuration is proud to be an equal opportunity employer, and as an organization committed to diversity and the perspective of all voices, we consider applicants equally of race, gender, color, sexual orientation, religion, marital status, disability, political affiliation and national origin. We reasonably accommodate staff members and/or applicants with disabilities, provided they are otherwise able to perform the essential functions of the job.

Note: Murmuration is two organizations working together to pursue our mission of amplifying the power of civic engagement: Murmuration Research Institute, a 501(c)(3) that conducts research to identify, design, and create the data, tools, and insights that build healthier and more equitable communities; and Murmuration, Inc., a 501(c)(4) that supports organizations working across the country on the nation’s most challenging issues with access to data, tools, and research that build healthier and more equitable communities.

We are currently seeking individuals who are interested in full-time opportunities.

Du kennst DATEV aus dem Arbeitsalltag und erklärst gerne Dinge, bis sie wirklich sitzen? Dann suchen wir dich - deutschlandweit, komplett im Homeoffice, in Voll- oder Teilzeit.

Wir sind die Digitalagentur1 und begleiten Steuerkanzleien in ganz Deutschland bei der Digitalisierung. Unsere Kunden sind ausschließlich Steuerberater. Deren Mandanten betreuen wir nicht selbst, aber wir machen die Kanzlei fit darin, ihre Mandanten sicher zu begleiten.

Deine Aufgaben

  • Beratung: Du begleitest Kanzleien bei Umstellungen, zum Beispiel auf digitale Belege, DATEV Unternehmen online oder neue Abläufe im Rechnungswesen und in der Personalwirtschaft.

  • Prozesse und Checklisten: Du hilfst uns, unsere internen Abläufe und Checklisten weiterzuentwickeln, damit jeder Vorgang nach demselben klaren Standard läuft.

  • Schulungsakademie: Du baust unsere interne Schulungsakademie mit aus - Unterlagen, Leitfäden und Lerninhalte, von denen das ganze Team profitiert.

Keine Sorge: Wir schulen dich komplett ein.

Du bekommst eine vollständige Einarbeitung in alle Themen, mit denen du zu tun hast. Wir gehen alles gemeinsam durch, üben es mit dir und lassen dich erst dann eigenständig arbeiten, wenn du dich sicher fühlst. Du musst also nicht alles schon können.

So arbeitest du bei uns

  • 100 % Homeoffice, deutschlandweit: Du brauchst nicht umzuziehen und nicht zu pendeln.

  • Feste Kernzeiten: Montag bis Donnerstag ab 8:30 Uhr, mindestens 5,5 Stunden am Tag - so sind wir für die Kanzleien verlässlich erreichbar.

  • Voll- oder Teilzeit: Der Mindestumfang liegt bei 22 Stunden pro Woche, Vollzeit sind 40 Stunden.

  • Alles digital: Termine, Schulungen und Support laufen online, keine Reisetätigkeit.

  • Klare Abläufe: Feste Prozesse statt Improvisation - du weißt jeden Tag, woran du bist.

Wir bieten

  • Sicherer Arbeitsplatz: Jede Person, die wir einstellen, soll langfristig mit uns wachsen. Das Ziel jeder Einstellung ist eine unbefristete Übernahme. Die Übernahmequote liegt aktuell bei über 95 %.

  • Tolle Arbeitsatmosphäre: Der Umgang untereinander ist sehr kollegial und familiär. Wir ziehen alle am gleichen Strang und motivieren uns gegenseitig, Bestleistungen zu erzielen und persönlich zu wachsen.

  • Volle Einarbeitung: Wir schulen dich in allen Themen ein und üben alles mit dir.

  • Moderne Technik und laufende Weiterbildung, damit du fachlich am Ball bleibst.

Zwei wichtige Hinweise

Die Tätigkeit ist ausschließlich aus Deutschland oder dem europäischen Ausland möglich. Und weil bei uns alles online läuft, brauchst du zu Hause eine stabile Internetleitung.

Noch mehr über uns

Wenn du weitere Informationen zu unserem Unternehmen und deiner Karriere bei Digitalagentur1 haben möchtest, findest du diese auf .

Auf unserem YouTube-Kanal erhältst du persönliche Einblicke in den Arbeitsalltag bei Digitalagentur1 - authentisch, direkt und auf Augenhöhe: .

Requirements

Das ist bei uns Voraussetzung

Du hast bereits mit mindestens einem dieser DATEV-Programme gearbeitet:

  • DATEV Rechnungswesen oder

  • DATEV Personalwirtschaft - also LODAS oder Lohn und Gehalt

Eines von beiden solltest du aus der Praxis kennen. Alles Weitere bringen wir dir bei.

Das solltest du außerdem mitbringen

  • Du erklärst gerne und hast Geduld, auch wenn du dieselbe Frage zum dritten Mal beantwortest.

  • Du arbeitest sorgfältig, verbindlich und hältst dich an vereinbarte Abläufe.

  • Du bist sicher am Rechner und findest dich in neuer Software schnell zurecht.

  • Du kommunizierst freundlich und klar - am Telefon genauso wie schriftlich.

Zu wem passt diese Position?

Du musst kein Steuerfachangestellter sein. Vielleicht kommst du aus einer Steuerkanzlei - oder du hast in einem Unternehmen gearbeitet, das mit DATEV arbeitet. Beides passt. Zu uns passen zum Beispiel Steuerfachangestellte, Finanzbuchhalter, Lohnbuchhalter, Bilanzbuchhalter oder Mitarbeiter aus der Kanzlei-Eigenorganisation.

Du hast bisher nur in einem Bereich gearbeitet?

Kein Problem. Ob Rechnungswesen oder Personalwirtschaft - den Rest bringen wir dir bei. Eine abgeschlossene Ausbildung in einem bestimmten Beruf ist keine Voraussetzung, deine Erfahrung zählt mehr als dein Abschluss.

Job Title: Technical Curriculum Developer - AI Agents

Job Location: Raleigh, NC, US

Job Location Type: Remote

Job Contract Type: Full-time

Job Seniority Level:

Veeva Systems is a mission-driven organization and pioneer in industry cloud, helping life sciences companies bring therapies to patients faster. As one of the fastest-growing SaaS companies in history, we surpassed $3B in revenue in our last fiscal year with extensive growth potential ahead.
At the heart of Veeva are our values: Do the Right Thing, Customer Success, Employee Success, and Speed. We're not just any public company – we made history in 2021 by becoming a public benefit corporation (PBC), legally bound to balancing the interests of customers, employees, society, and investors.
As a Work Anywhere company, we support your flexibility to work from home or in the office, so you can thrive in your ideal environment.
Join us in transforming the life sciences industry, committed to making a positive impact on its customers, employees, and communities.

The Role

This is not a traditional curriculum developer role - please do not apply if you have dabbled with AI agents. In this unique role, we are accepting applications for two different personas:
    • The AI Solutions Engineer turned Mentor/Coach - you have an engineering/development background and have become the AI/Technical Trainer to teach learners how AI agents to build and configure agents and AI best practices.
    • The Technical Curriculum Developer turned AI Builder - you have a passion for teaching others deep technical topics, and have the curiosity and drive to learn and vibe code agentic solutions/integrations.
If you are one of these profiles and have proven, demonstrable experience - please apply now!
You'll build the training that teaches customers, partners and Veevans how to use, configure, and implement and integrate our platform — including its Agentic AI capabilities — and you'll build the AI agents that power our demos and hands-on labs.
You should be able to walk into an unfamiliar product area, understand its architecture and APIs, and within days be building working agent demos and lab exercises around it.
You'll also own and evolve our most technical training courses, the coding-intensive classes that require real Java and REST API fluency, bringing rigor and firsthand credibility that generalist curriculum developers can't.

What You'll Do

AI Agent Curriculum & Enablement

    • Design and build hands-on training and lab environments that teach technical learners how to build, configure, and deploy custom AI agents on our platform
    • Build working AI agent demos and reference implementations from scratch to anchor training content and live demonstrations
    • Translate the practical challenges learners face when configuring or implementing Agentic AI — tool/function calling, context management, prompt design, error handling, guardrails, orchestration — into clear, sequenced learning experiences
    • Stay current with the agentic AI landscape (frameworks, MCP-style tool integrations, agent orchestration patterns)

Technical Curriculum Development

    • Own and maintain our advanced technical courses, including classes that require coding in Java and working with REST APIs
    • Build and maintain hands-on lab environments, sample code, sandbox data, and technical exercises that mirror real implementation scenarios
    • Partner with Product and Engineering to get early access to new features and build courseware alongside General release
    • Apply instructional design best practices (learning objectives, scaffolding, assessment design, adult learning principles) to technical content without watering down technical accuracy

Cross-Functional Collaboration

    • Work closely with Product Management and Engineering to understand agent architecture, APIs, and configuration options as they're being built
    • Partner with Professional Services, Managed Services and Customer Support to identify pain points and close those gaps with curriculum

Requirements

    • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Instructional Design, or equivalent practical experience
    • Hands-on experience building, configuring, and deploying AI agents (e.g., using frameworks/SDKs such as LangChain, LangGraph, Anthropic's Claude Agent SDK/Claude Code, or similar)
    • Practical understanding of core agent concepts: tool/function calling, retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), context/memory management, multi-agent orchestration, prompt engineering, and evaluation
    • Experience with the Model Context Protocol (MCP) or comparable tool-integration standards is a strong plus
    • First-hand experience troubleshooting the real problems agent builders hit — flaky tool calls, context overflow, hallucinated actions, permission/scoping issues — so you can teach learners to anticipate and solve them, not just follow a script
    • Ability to read and understand Java code architecture and classes for minor development or debugging, alongside a strong foundational knowledge of REST APIs
    • Experience with Git, Postman, or similar API tooling
    • 3+ years building technical training, curriculum, or enablement content for a technical audience (developers, implementation consultants, technical admins, or power users)
    • Experience designing hands-on labs, sandbox exercises, and high quality instructor-led courses and/or eLearning
    • Familiarity with LMS platforms and AI/authoring tools (e.g., Articulate, Camtasia, Arcade, Vyond, Gemini, Claude or similar) is a plus
    • Experience with Veeva Vault, or ability to quickly ramp up on, complex enterprise SaaS platforms — including how Veeva Vault is configured and implemented by customers
    • Self-directed and comfortable with ambiguity — this role will often be defining the curriculum for capabilities that are still being built
    • Strong writing and technical communication skills; able to explain complex technical concepts clearly to varied audiences (technical and semi-technical learners)
    • Strong presentation and facilitation skills; comfortable leading live demos and workshops

Interviewing with Veeva

We value your time and believe in a transparent hiring process. Here is the process you can expect.

    • Follow the application process and submit your resume.
    • Within 3 days, you will receive a link to a personality assessment administered by a third party.
    • Once you complete the assessment, our team will review your full application package and follow up via email with our decision.
    • If moving to the interview stage, the process is as follows:
        1. A conversation with the hiring manager
        2. A practical case exercise
        3. A final conversation with our group's Senior Leader.
    • Once all interviews are complete, the manager will be in touch with a final decision.

Perks & Benefits

    • Medical, dental, vision, and basic life insurance
    • Flexible PTO and company paid holidays
    • Retirement programs
    • 1% charitable giving program

Compensation

    • Base pay: $100,000 - $175,000
    • The salary range listed here has been provided to comply with local regulations and represents a potential base salary range for this role. Please note that actual salaries may vary within the range above or below, depending on experience and location. We look at compensation for each individual and base our offer on your unique qualifications, experience, and expected contributions. This position may also be eligible for other types of compensation in addition to base salary, such as variable bonus and/or stock bonus.
Veeva’s headquarters is located in the San Francisco Bay Area with offices in more than 15 countries around the world.

About the Program:

Every year, we sponsor 2 remote UX apprentices from anywhere in the world to join us for 7 months, either in the fall or spring seasons or online. Our UX apprentices work through the end-to-end UX design and UX research process for a startup idea of their choice that will help them attract hiring managers in that topic space or industry.

Apprentices take our program for free and receive 1:1 mentorship throughout the 7-month program. Alumni UX apprentices go on to make between $85,000 -$130,000 in UX design, product design, UX research, or service design roles after they complete the program.

We are committed to helping women, immigrants, POC, and LGBTQ folks break into tech and land 6-figure UX jobs. We help you land 6-figure UX jobs or coach you till you get it.

Apprenticeship Requirements:

This apprenticeship program is open to new grads and UX career changers alike! Here are some apprenticeship requirements to keep in mind before applying:

  • Interested in creative career paths in UX research, UX design, product design or service design
  • Willing to commit 5-10 hours of work per week to complete program deliverables
  • Willing to attend 2-3 hour weekend lectures to learn the end-to-end design process OR willing to complete online video course modules
  • Open to feedback from UX mentors and demonstrates a willingness to revise design work

Apprenticeship Program Learnings:

  • Build digital products and services 0-1
  • Lead end-to-end design process for a startup idea or topic of your choice
  • Lead product scoping and feature scoping, as well as entire project management
  • Identify target market for product and position product for launch success
  • Incorporate AI tools into your UX design process
  • Design AI features and products by considering AI specific design parameters and heuristics
  • Understand how AI works and advocate for ethical AI design that builds trust without over-reliance with users
  • Develop a business model for the product or service and demonstrate how the product/service will scale as the business model scales
  • Lead discovery research by managing user recruitment, creating research plans, writing interview guides, leading 8-16 discovery interviews, and synthesizing interview insights
  • Deliver a compelling UX design and business pitch for your startup idea, showcasing both qualitative and quantitative data to justify the problem space and the solution
  • Tell a compelling story about users by showcasing user types, personas, stakeholder maps, journey maps, process maps, service blueprints, ideation matrixes, sketches, wireframes, UX workflows, prototypes and other visual deliverables
  • Lead user testing of wireframes and prototypes to improve product/service usability and constantly iterate on your startup idea
  • Design a unique design system for your solution from scratch, creating components, a style guide, and branding for your solution
  • Analyze direct and indirect competitors to clearly articulate your solution’s differentiators and why your solution is innovative and more likely to succeed over competing options
  • Consult with startups to create a scope of work and fulfill UX research, UX design, product design and service design work based on your scope of work.

How to Apply:

Please fill out our application form to apply for UX Woman sponsoring your participation in the program. The application takes 5 minutes to complete and will ask you to send in your LinkedIn profile and resume, as well as ask you about why you are interested in this program. You do NOT need to have a UX resume or portfolio to apply- we consider folks who are at the very beginning of their career change, who are still exploring multiple career options.

You will receive UX tips and challenges via email to help you with your transition into UX and will be contacted by us if you are being considered for the apprentice program. Once contacted, you will go through a brief interview process before joining the cohort. Due to the large volume of applicants, we cannot contact all applicants about their application status.If you don’t hear from us about an interview within 2 months of applying, please consider your application closed. We consider applicants on a rolling basis.

jobs.excerpt: Position SummaryThe Chief Risk Officer (CRO) – Retail Banking is responsible for establishing and leading the enterprise-wide risk management framework for the retail banking business.
jobs.description:
Position Summary

The Chief Risk Officer (CRO) – Retail Banking is responsible for establishing and leading the enterprise-wide risk management framework for the retail banking business. The CRO oversees credit, operational, market, liquidity, compliance, fraud, cyber, conduct, and reputational risks while ensuring alignment with the bank's strategic objectives, regulatory requirements, and risk appetite.

The role provides independent oversight and challenge to business activities, safeguarding the institution's financial stability, customers, and reputation while enabling sustainable growth.

Key Responsibilities

Enterprise Risk Management

  • Develop and maintain the retail banking risk management framework.
  • Establish risk appetite statements, risk limits, and governance standards.
  • Ensure effective identification, assessment, monitoring, and mitigation of risks.
  • Provide independent oversight of business decisions and strategic initiatives.
  • Promote a strong risk culture throughout the organization.

Credit Risk Management

  • Oversee retail credit portfolios, including:
    • Mortgages
    • Personal Loans
    • Credit Cards
    • Auto Loans
    • Consumer Finance Products
  • Establish underwriting standards and credit policies.
  • Monitor portfolio quality, delinquency trends, and loss performance.
  • Lead stress testing and credit risk scenario analyses.
  • Recommend risk-adjusted lending strategies.

Operational Risk Management

  • Develop frameworks to identify and manage operational risks.
  • Monitor operational incidents, control failures, and emerging risks.
  • Oversee business continuity and operational resilience programs.
  • Strengthen internal controls and risk reporting mechanisms.
  • Ensure effective risk and control self-assessment processes.

Regulatory Compliance & Conduct Risk

  • Ensure compliance with banking regulations and consumer protection laws.
  • Oversee conduct risk management and fair customer treatment initiatives.
  • Maintain strong relationships with regulatory authorities.
  • Lead regulatory examinations and risk-related audits.
  • Ensure implementation of regulatory changes and risk controls.

Fraud & Financial Crime Risk

  • Oversee fraud prevention, detection, and investigation programs.
  • Strengthen anti-money laundering (AML) and counter-terrorist financing controls.
  • Monitor financial crime risks and emerging threats.
  • Ensure effective transaction monitoring and suspicious activity reporting.
  • Collaborate with law enforcement and regulatory agencies when necessary.

Market & Liquidity Risk Oversight

  • Monitor interest rate risk and liquidity risk exposures.
  • Evaluate balance sheet vulnerabilities and stress scenarios.
  • Support asset-liability management activities.
  • Ensure adherence to regulatory capital and liquidity requirements.

Cybersecurity & Technology Risk

  • Oversee technology and cyber risk governance.
  • Assess cybersecurity threats and resilience capabilities.
  • Ensure robust controls for digital banking platforms.
  • Monitor third-party and vendor risk exposures.
  • Support digital transformation initiatives through effective risk management.

Governance & Reporting

  • Present risk reports to Executive Management, Risk Committees, and the Board.
  • Develop key risk indicators (KRIs) and risk dashboards.
  • Ensure timely escalation of significant risk issues.
  • Maintain effective risk governance structures and committee frameworks.

Leadership & Talent Development

  • Lead risk management teams across multiple disciplines.
  • Develop future risk leaders and succession plans.
  • Foster a culture of accountability, integrity, and transparency.
  • Promote collaboration across business, compliance, audit, and technology functions.

Qualifications

Education

  • Bachelor's degree in Finance, Economics, Accounting, Business Administration, Risk Management, Mathematics, or a related discipline.
  • Master's degree (MBA, Finance, Economics, Risk Management, or related field) preferred.

Professional Certifications

Preferred certifications include:

  • Financial Risk Manager (FRM)
  • Professional Risk Manager (PRM)
  • Chartered Financial Analyst (CFA)
  • Certified Anti-Money Laundering Specialist (CAMS)

Experience

  • 15+ years of progressive banking and risk management experience.
  • Extensive experience within retail banking risk management.
  • Proven leadership experience overseeing enterprise risk functions.
  • Experience interacting with regulators, boards, and executive committees.
  • Strong understanding of consumer lending, deposits, payments, and digital banking.
  • Experience leading large, multidisciplinary risk teams.

Technical Competencies

  • Enterprise Risk Management (ERM)
  • Retail Credit Risk
  • Operational Risk
  • Regulatory Compliance
  • Financial Crime Risk
  • Fraud Risk Management
  • AML/KYC Frameworks
  • Market Risk
  • Liquidity Risk
  • Capital Adequacy Management
  • Cybersecurity Risk
  • Operational Resilience
  • Stress Testing
  • Risk Analytics & Modeling
  • Governance, Risk & Compliance (GRC)

Leadership Competencies

  • Strategic Leadership
  • Risk-Based Decision Making
  • Executive Communication
  • Board & Regulatory Engagement
  • Crisis Management
  • Ethical Leadership
  • Stakeholder Management
  • Change Leadership
  • Problem Solving
  • Team Development

Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

  • Credit Loss Ratio
  • Non-Performing Loan (NPL) Ratio
  • Portfolio Delinquency Rates
  • Operational Loss Events
  • Regulatory Findings and Remediation
  • Fraud Loss Reduction
  • AML Compliance Effectiveness
  • Cyber Risk Incident Metrics
  • Risk Appetite Compliance
  • Capital and Liquidity Adequacy

jobs.title: Senior Production Engineering Manager
jobs.excerpt: Hey, g'day, mabuhay, kia ora, 你好, hallo, vítejte!
jobs.description:
Hey, g'day, mabuhay, kia ora, 你好, hallo, vítejte!

Thanks for stopping by. We know job hunting can be a little time consuming and you're probably keen to find out what's on offer, so we'll get straight to the point.

What you'd be doing in this role:

This Engineering Manager role leads Embedded, one of Production Engineering's two teams.

You'll lead a technically strong group of engineers, deliberately weighted toward senior talent, working simultaneously across several of Canva's most important production challenges. Right now, those engagements include safeguarding critical data, making software changes safer, building reliability and observability into a major platform rewrite, and building tooling and frameworks to allow services to increase resilience to overload scenarios.

Because Embedded works alongside teams outside your reporting line, the role depends as much on influence as authority. You'll need to earn the trust of engineering leaders quickly, help your engineers navigate different technical and organisational environments, and stay close enough to the work to challenge assumptions and shape important technical decisions.

Embedded is still new, so you won't be stepping into a finished playbook. You'll help decide which problems the team takes on, how engagements should work, what great looks like, and how we measure whether Production Engineering is having the impact we intended.

You'll also be responsible for creating an environment where experienced engineers can do their best work: setting direction, building psychological safety, giving direct coaching and helping senior engineers grow their technical and organisational influence.

Looking ahead, this role will help build:

  • Impact where it matters most: Focus Embedded on the production problems where it can make the biggest difference, build trust with engineering leaders so the team is brought in early, and make that impact visible through measurable outcomes.

  • A model that scales: Work out how Embedded can run more engagements without losing the technical bar, coaching quality or close partnerships that make the model effective.

  • Standards worth reusing: Turn lessons from individual engagements into engineering practices, patterns and capabilities that can benefit teams across Canva.

  • The next generation of leaders: Develop senior engineers and engagement leads who can coach others, lead increasingly complex work and multiply the team's impact.

You’re probably a match:

We'd love to hear from you if you fit one or more of these. You don't need to meet all of them, but the more the better and if you join the team, we're invested in helping you grow.

Experience:

  • Leading senior engineers: You've led highly experienced software engineers and technical leads through complex or ambiguous work, and know how to coach people operating with significant autonomy.

  • Production exposure: You've worked in software environments where reliability, scalability and production risk genuinely mattered.

  • Earned authority: You've built trust from a standing start, particularly in environments where influence mattered more than reporting lines.

  • Cross-org delivery: You've led significant technical initiatives spanning multiple teams or groups, from understanding the problem through to delivering an outcome.

  • Driving adoption: You've persuaded teams to change how they build or operate software, even when they were busy, skeptical or already had an established way of working.

  • Engineering leadership: You can communicate complex technical trade-offs to senior stakeholders while creating an environment where engineers can challenge ideas, learn, receive direct feedback and do their best work.

Technical knowledge:

  • CS fundamentals: A strong grounding in computer science fundamentals, including concurrency, multithreading and data structures.

  • Language depth: Enough depth in languages such as Go, Python, Java or C++ to engage meaningfully with designs, implementation choices and technical trade-offs.

  • Systems knowledge: Strong working knowledge of system internals, networking and cloud platforms such as AWS or GCP.

  • Systems thinking: Comfortable reasoning through ambiguous problems spanning multiple components, teams and constraints, with a strong understanding of system design, architecture and engineering patterns.

  • Reliability engineering: Familiarity with observability, capacity, failure modes and the operational characteristics of production systems.

  • Scale and criticality: Experience working in large-scale or high-criticality environments where reliability failures have meaningful consequences for users, systems or the business.

Nice to have:

  • SRE/PE management: Prior experience leading Site Reliability Engineering, Production Engineering or a closely related function

  • Infrastructure exposure: Experience with large-scale storage, CDN, networking or distributed infrastructure

  • Growing technical leaders: A history of developing senior engineers and technical leads who can coach others and take on increasingly complex work

  • Function-building: Experience helping define the identity, operating model or scope of a technical function while it was still taking shape

About the Group and Team:

Production Engineering sits within Canva's Reliability Platform subgroup, part of the wider Infra supergroup responsible for the foundations Canva's engineering teams build on, including compute, storage, networking, developer experience and reliability.

At more than 250 million monthly active users, Canva's hardest reliability problems increasingly span systems, teams and organisational boundaries. Production Engineering exists to help keep Canva reliable, efficient and predictable as that complexity grows.

It's primarily a software engineering function. Rather than operating systems from the sidelines or papering over problems with process, Production Engineers solve operational challenges through design and code.

The function is split into two teams: Embedded and Core.

Embedded works directly alongside teams across Canva on targeted, long-running engineering engagements. Engineers typically work in small groups, combining senior technical leadership with engineers who can learn from the engagement and help carry that knowledge forward.

Core owns Production Engineering services and works on broader problems that cut across multiple teams or groups. When an Embedded engagement uncovers an idea worth applying more widely, Embedded and Core can work together to turn that learning into reusable capability across Canva.

Embedded is deliberately weighted toward senior technical talent. Production Engineers need to enter unfamiliar problem spaces, understand complex systems quickly and earn credibility with the engineers who already own them.

Because the function is still taking shape, the team is also defining its own identity: where Production Engineering can have the greatest impact, how it partners with other teams, and how individual wins become lasting engineering capability across Canva.

What’s in it for you?

Achieving our crazy big goals motivates us to work hard — and we do — but you'll experience lots of moments of magic, connectivity and fun woven throughout life at Canva, too. We also offer a range of benefits to set you up for every success in and outside of work.

Here's a taste of what's on offer:

  • Equity packages — we want our success to be yours too

  • Inclusive parental leave policy that supports all parents & carers

  • An annual Vibe & Thrive allowance to support your wellbeing, social connection, office setup & more

  • Flexible leave options that empower you to be a force for good, take time to recharge and support you personally

Other stuff to know?

We see AI as a powerful amplifier of creativity and technology at Canva. We're evolving how we assess AI skills in our Technology hiring experience — you'll tackle interactive, real-time challenges that reflect the kind of work we do. In some interviews, you may also be asked to solve a problem using an AI tool to show how you approach challenges with tech by your side.

We make hiring decisions based on your experience, skills and passion, as well as how you can enhance Canva and our culture.

When you apply, please tell us the pronouns you use and any reasonable adjustments you may need during the interview process. We celebrate all types of skills and backgrounds at Canva, so even if you don't feel like your skills quite match what's listed above — we still want to hear from you!

Please note that interviews are conducted virtually.

Social Media Marketing Manager

Remote | Brazil

Compensation: $9.00 to $15.00 USD/hour, based on experience

Schedule: 6 hours/day, Monday through Friday, with at least a 4-hour overlap during US business hours

Employment Type: Long-term, part-time contractor role with room to grow based on performance

About DrHouse

DrHouse is a fast-growing telehealth company making healthcare more accessible for patients across the United States.

Social media is a key part of our growth strategy. Our goal is not simply to gain followers. We create content that builds trust, educates consumers, and motivates people to use DrHouse when they need care.

The Role

We are looking for someone who thinks like a marketer, not just a social media coordinator.

This role requires previous experience managing social media for a healthcare, telehealth, health-tech, SaaS, or technology brand. You should understand how to create content that builds trust, educates audiences, and drives measurable business results in fast-paced, regulated industries.

You will build and manage 30-day campaigns that support our marketing strategy, seasonal healthcare trends, email campaigns, website content, product launches, promotions, and business priorities.

You should be comfortable taking ownership, identifying opportunities, and bringing new ideas to the table without waiting for detailed instructions.

If you need to be told exactly what to do every day, this is not the right role.

What You Will Own

  • Build and maintain a rolling 30-day content calendar that is always at least 30 days ahead.
  • Create engaging content for LinkedIn, Instagram, Facebook, TikTok, and YouTube Shorts.
  • Write platform-specific copy that sounds human, builds trust, and encourages people to take action.
  • Design graphics, carousels, reels, and short-form videos using Canva and other editing tools.
  • Align social content with ongoing email campaigns, website content, seasonal health needs, promotions, healthcare awareness moments, and timely reasons consumers may need telemedicine.
  • Create content that encourages US consumers to visit the website, download the app, start a consultation, and complete a telemedicine visit.
  • Repurpose content strategically across platforms instead of simply copying and pasting the same post everywhere.
  • Complete a minimum of 20 meaningful engagement activities every business day across LinkedIn and Instagram. Comments must be thoughtful, personalized, and add value. Generic or automated comments are not acceptable.
  • Maintain an engagement tracker with links to posts, engagement completed, target accounts, and recommended follow-up opportunities.
  • Monitor comments and messages on DrHouse content and draft timely responses.
  • Bring new campaign ideas, content opportunities, and organic growth experiments to the team.
  • Deliver a concise weekly report highlighting results, insights, recommendations, blockers, and priorities for the following week.
  • Communicate early when a deadline is at risk. Silence, missed follow-ups, and incomplete assignments are not acceptable.

Content Priorities

  • Three LinkedIn posts per week.
  • Three Instagram posts per week, with selected content repurposed for Facebook.
  • Two short-form videos per week, repurposed for Instagram Reels, TikTok, and YouTube Shorts.
  • Daily LinkedIn and Instagram engagement.
  • Timely responses to comments on published posts.

Success Measures

  • Qualified organic traffic from social media.
  • Website visits, app downloads, consultations started, and completed telemedicine visits influenced by social campaigns.
  • Engagement quality and relevant audience growth.
  • Consistently meeting deadlines and maintaining a 30-day-ahead content calendar.
  • Proactive ideas that improve content performance and business results.

Approval & Quality Standards

Initially, all calendars, copy, graphics, and videos must be submitted for approval before publishing. Greater publishing autonomy may be provided after you demonstrate strong judgment, consistency, and knowledge of the DrHouse brand.

You are responsible for checking spelling, links, formatting, brand consistency, and accuracy before submitting work.

Because we operate in healthcare, all content must be accurate, responsible, and aligned with approved company messaging. Unsupported health claims will not be published.

What We're Looking For

Required Qualifications

  • Minimum 3+ years of experience managing social media for a healthcare, telehealth, health-tech, SaaS, or technology brand.
  • Proven experience creating social media campaigns that produced measurable business results.
  • A strong portfolio demonstrating successful campaigns, content creation, and audience growth.
  • Excellent written and spoken English.
  • Strong copywriting skills with the ability to create engaging, platform-specific content.
  • Advanced Canva skills and experience creating graphics, carousels, reels, and short-form videos.
  • Experience editing short-form videos for Instagram Reels, TikTok, and YouTube Shorts.
  • Strong understanding of LinkedIn, Instagram, Facebook, TikTok, and YouTube best practices.
  • Experience using analytics to optimize content performance and make data-driven decisions.
  • A sharp visual eye and strong attention to detail.
  • Highly organized, self-directed, proactive, and able to work independently without constant supervision.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience working with US healthcare or telehealth companies.
  • Experience marketing healthcare, SaaS, or technology products to US consumers.
  • Experience supporting demand generation, product launches, or performance marketing campaigns.

AI can support research and ideation, but generic or unedited AI-generated content is not a fit.

To Apply

Please include the following with your application:

  • Your resume highlighting your experience managing social media for a healthcare, telehealth, health-tech, SaaS, or technology company.
  • Three to five examples of social campaigns or content you personally created.
  • Briefly explain your role in creating each example.
  • Share the measurable results each campaign or piece of content produced.
  • Include links to social media accounts or content you currently manage.
  • List the tools you use for graphics, video editing, scheduling, engagement, and analytics.
  • Share your availability during US business hours.
  • Provide your requested hourly rate.

Final candidates will be invited to complete a short paid assessment involving social media strategy, copywriting, and creative execution.

Salary: $9 – $15 / hour

Atlas Technica’s mission is to shoulder IT management, user support, and cybersecurity for our clients, who are hedge funds and other investment firms. Founded in 2016, we have grown year over year through our uncompromising focus on service.

We value ownership, execution, growth, intelligence, and camaraderie. We are looking for people who share our Core Values, thrive, and contribute to this environment while putting the customer first. Position Overview

This is a highly visible, client-facing role focused primarily on the successful technical onboarding of new clients, as well as the delivery of infrastructure, cloud, cybersecurity, and technology transformation projects for existing clients.

The Sr. Project Engineer is responsible for assessing client environments, designing and implementing technical solutions, developing detailed transition plans, and ensuring projects are completed according to scope, timeline, and established technical standards. This individual will work closely with clients, Project Managers, Project Engineers, Systems Engineers, and other internal stakeholders to communicate progress, resolve technical challenges, and deliver a seamless client experience.

The successful candidate will combine strong hands-on technical expertise with organization, ownership, sound judgment, and the ability to clearly communicate with both technical and non-technical audiences. This role also serves as a technical escalation point and mentor for other engineers, providing strong opportunities for continued professional, technical, and leadership growth.

jobs.title: Product & Content Marketing Specialist / Manager
jobs.excerpt: Intellect is a global leader in mental health benefits, trusted by the world’s most forward-thinking employers, insurers, and governments to deliver care that is local, personalised, and effective at scale.
jobs.description:
Intellect is a global leader in mental health benefits, trusted by the world’s most forward-thinking employers, insurers, and governments to deliver care that is local, personalised, and effective at scale. Today, we serve over 4 million people across 100+ countries and territories, making mental health support truly accessible across borders and cultures.

Our platform powers the mental wellbeing of workforces at Fortune 500 companies like Dell, Bytedance, Visa, Shell, McDonald’s, and hundreds more, enabling them to support their people with the highest standards of clinical quality, cultural relevance, and on-demand accessibility.

Driven by our mission to build the world’s most trusted mental health benefits platform, Intellect combines a best-in-class digital platform with a world-leading global provider network to deliver unmatched client outcomes and transformative care experiences.

We are backed by top global investors including Tiger Global, Y Combinator, Insignia Ventures Partners, HOF Capital, K3 Ventures, JAFCO, Headline, East Ventures, IHH Healthcare, MS&AD Ventures, and more, alongside an extensive coalition of notable family offices, big tech executives, and leading angel investors.

The Role

We’re looking for a product and content marketer to sharpen how Intellect competes, communicate the value of our solutions and turn that understanding into content that helps buyers choose us and clients get more from our offering.

Product marketing is at the centre of this role. You’ll build buyer and competitive insight, own positioning and messaging, and lead marketing planning for priority solution launches. Your remit spans Intellect’s digital products, care services and enterprise solutions.

You’ll also personally create the content that brings our positioning to life - from sales materials and customer stories to white papers, thought leadership and client communications. Working with our Clinical team, you’ll draw on research, evidence and subject-matter expertise to build credible, differentiated narratives. You’ll help strengthen Intellect’s brand, organic visibility and customer engagement through a focused, coordinated marketing plan.

Working directly with B2B marketing, sales, client success, product and clinical teams, you’ll have meaningful ownership of both the thinking and the execution.

This is a hands-on individual contributor role. We’re open to hiring at Specialist or Manager level, depending on your experience and demonstrated ability to independently own and deliver this work.

Your Responsibilities

Product Marketing & Go-to-Market

  • Build buyer and competitive insight through customer conversations, sales feedback and reviews of won and lost opportunities, identifying buying priorities, objections and reasons to choose Intellect.
  • Own positioning, differentiation and value propositions across Intellect’s solutions, tailoring messaging to priority buyer segments and markets.
  • Lead marketing planning for priority solution launches and updates, defining target audiences, messaging, supporting evidence and sales readiness, with B2B marketing owning acquisition campaign execution.
  • Bring customer and market insights into discussions with product, clinical and commercial teams to inform how solutions are developed, packaged and communicated.

Commercial Content & Sales Enablement

  • Personally research, write and edit compelling sales decks, solution materials, customer stories, case studies and campaign content.
  • Identify barriers to purchase with sales and develop messaging, objection-handling resources and competitive positioning materials that help address them.
  • Partner with the Clinical team to translate research findings, clinical expertise and customer outcomes into clear, credible evidence that helps buyers evaluate Intellect and supports renewal and expansion conversations.
  • Keep core materials current and easy to use, assessing their usefulness through adoption, sales feedback and buyer responses.

Website, SEO & AI Search Visibility

  • Own core website content and routine CMS updates, ensuring our solutions, differentiation and customer evidence are clearly presented.
  • Improve organic discovery through search-informed content and practical on-page SEO, prioritising relevant audiences and commercial intent.
  • Test approaches to improve visibility in AI-powered search and answer platforms, building on useful, authoritative content and sound SEO foundations.
  • Use search and content performance to prioritise improvements, working with B2B marketing on conversion and specialists on technical changes.

Brand Communications, Thought Leadership & PR

  • Maintain a consistent voice and narrative across Intellect’s public and client-facing communications.
  • Collaborate with the Clinical team on research-led content and white papers, bringing buyer-relevant questions into topic planning and turning findings and subject-matter expertise into accessible narratives, with clinical review for accuracy.
  • Develop thought leadership, articles and executive content that connect Intellect’s expertise and perspectives to the issues facing employers and their people.
  • Own a focused editorial calendar for organic social and ongoing brand communications, coordinating creative support through to publication.
  • Develop company announcements, press materials and story angles; coordinate leadership approvals, routine media enquiries and outreach with specialist PR support where needed.

Customer Marketing & Lifecycle Communications

  • Plan and execute repeatable client programmes, including onboarding communications, newsletters, solution education and engagement journeys.
  • Personally manage client audience segments, email distribution and straightforward CRM workflows, coordinating targeting and timing with client success.
  • Develop communications that demonstrate ongoing value and introduce relevant additional services, supporting engagement, renewal and expansion.
  • Equip client success with reusable templates and materials for account-specific deployment.

Planning & Effectiveness

  • Translate business priorities into a focused plan, protecting time for positioning, launches and commercial content alongside recurring communications.
  • Assess effectiveness through sales adoption, buyer feedback, relevant search visibility, customer engagement and contribution to commercial programmes.
  • Build reusable assets and workflows, using AI and other tools to improve execution while maintaining accuracy, originality and editorial quality.

Requirements

  • Strong in product-marketing judgement. You can demonstrate how you have shaped positioning, messaging or a go-to-market approach using buyer insight, and explain the decisions behind your work.
  • An excellent hands-on writer and editor. You can turn complex products and services into clear, persuasive content, with work samples that show both your thinking and your personal contribution.
  • Commercially minded. You understand how enterprise buyers evaluate solutions and can connect your work to buying decisions, sales effectiveness and customer value.
  • An independent owner. You can identify gaps, propose priorities, gather inputs and deliver work without needing every step prescribed. You make sensible trade-offs and know when to seek input.
  • Comfortable with website publishing and SEO. You can manage content through a CMS, apply on-page SEO fundamentals and use data to improve performance. You’re curious and practical about emerging AI search opportunities.
  • Able to execute customer marketing. You can use CRM and email tools to segment audiences, run communications and build straightforward lifecycle workflows.
  • Confident working with experts and evidence. You can draw useful insights from specialists and research, communicate findings accurately and distinguish supported claims from overstatement. You do not need a clinical background, but should be comfortable learning complex subject matter.
  • Organised and collaborative. You work effectively with commercial teams, product and clinical experts, leadership and creative partners, managing competing priorities with sound judgement.
  • Motivated by the mission. You’re excited to make mental healthcare easier to understand and access, and connect strong product marketing and storytelling with meaningful business growth.
  • Open to candidates in Malaysia (hybrid), Singapore (hybrid), Philippines (remote) and Indonesia (remote)

We value demonstrated ownership and work quality over a particular title or rigid years-of-experience requirement. Experience with enterprise audiences, multiple markets, healthcare, employee benefits, HR technology or complex services would be an advantage. Experience in research-led content, PR, executive communications or AI search optimisation (GEO/AEO) is also welcome.

Benefits

Why You’ll Love Working With Us:

  • Global company – work in a diverse environment with people from nearly 20 countries
  • Generous leave policy – time off to rest and recharge
  • Christmas week off – company-wide break during Christmas, separate from annual leave
  • Birthday leave – enjoy a day off on your birthday
  • Quarterly mental health days – one day off every quarter to focus on your wellbeing
  • Flexible work arrangements – work in a way that suits your lifestyle and goals
  • Work-life balance – a culture that values personal time and long-term wellness
  • Medical coverage – comprehensive insurance for peace of mind
  • Performance bonus – high performance is recognised and rewarded
  • Development budget - annual allowance to support your professional development
  • Mental health support – premium coaching access to our mental health app and resources & dedicated budget for clinical and psychiatric care
  • Socialsand communities – regular non-work events/activities to connect and have fun together

jobs.excerpt: About FloatFloat is the full-stack platform for Specialty Pharma home infusion.
jobs.description:
About Float

Float is the full-stack platform for Specialty Pharma home infusion. We’re on a mission to make healthcare safer, easier, and more efficient by connecting SuperNurses to home medication visits - moving all care that doesn’t need a hospital to the home.

Float connects nurses with patients so they can get treatments for their chronic conditions in the home rather than going into the overcrowded hospital. Our model benefits all stakeholders - patients get more convenient care, nurses access flexible work for better pay, pharmacies fill more prescriptions, hospitals reduce low-reimbursement admissions, and payors enjoy 12x reduced costs with home-delivered care.

Over the last 5 years, we’ve successfully demonstrated multi-state expansion, validated strong unit economics, and boast remarkable retention of patients, nurses, and pharmacies. We’ve facilitated over 100,000 patient visits with 1,100 nurses and are scaling our platform, team, and operations to serve more geographies and patients.

Float Health is currently recruiting nurses and serving patients in California, Nevada, Arizona, Texas, Washington, Michigan, Indiana, Georgia, and Ohio with several new states on the horizon.

The Role

As an Intake Specialist, you’ll play a key role in our operations and customer success by managing new patient referrals and coordinating timely start-of-care visits. These visits are typically more urgent than routine healthcare appointments, so your ability to act quickly, communicate clearly, and manage details with precision will directly impact patient outcomes and satisfaction.

You’ll serve as a liaison between specialty pharmacies, nurses, and patients—leveraging technology platforms to ensure smooth coordination, timely staffing, and successful care delivery. This is an externally facing role that requires excellent organizational skills, strong attention to detail, and a proactive, solution-oriented mindset.

Customer service is central to this position. As the first point of contact for patients, pharmacies, and nurses, you’ll represent Float Health with empathy, professionalism, and efficiency. Your ability to resolve issues quickly and accurately will help build trust and drive a seamless experience for all stakeholders.

You’ll contribute to achieving company goals by making staffing decisions aligned with operational and financial objectives. You’ll need to be flexible and adaptable as priorities shift. We're looking for someone who is highly engaged and eager to identify opportunities to improve our workflows, technology, and overall user experience.

Who you are

  • You’re flexible and have a learner mindset: we’re a start up, we move fast and are constantly improving.
  • You thrive in urgency: our patients are sometimes discharged directly from the hospital to home visits on short notice, you are a key part of their care delivery.
  • You’re team-oriented: in a remote role, strong teammate connections are more important than ever.
  • You have a strong sense of accountability and integrity: external customers and internal team members will rely on you everyday.

What you’ll do:

  • Utilize the Float Health platform and supporting technology (Zendesk, Google Suite, Slack) to coordinate start of care visits, including:
    • Collecting information from pharmacies and patients
    • Matching appropriate nurses to patients
    • Managing offers in our marketplace to ensure we pay the nurses a responsible rate
    • Onboarding patients to Float Health
    • Confirming logistics and schedules with all users to ensure a safe and seamless home visit
    • Responding to restaff and reschedule requests as they arise
  • Communicate clearly, kindly, and proactively with specialty pharmacies, nurses, and patients via email, phone calls, chat, and SMS
    • Respond to Inbound phone calls, emails, chat, and SMS as well as initiating outbound
  • Work cross functionally with internal teams in shared queues and Slack to ensure visit documentation and other visit related tasks are completed
  • Prioritize and coordinate multiple tasks simultaneously
  • Learn new processes and technology continuously
  • Develop and maintain positive relationships with peers at specialty pharmacies
  • Complete tasks related to pharmacy engagement as needed
  • Provide feedback to improve our technology and processes

Required skills:

  • 1+ years of experience with medical scheduling
  • Ability to utilize multiple technology platforms simultaneously
  • Ability to manage inbound communication while supporting other tasks
  • Ability to type 60 words per minute with high accuracy
  • Excellent critical thinking and problem-solving abilities
  • Highly organized with excellent time management skills
  • Exceptional customer service skills
  • Exceptional written and verbal communication, including the ability to digest and explain complex information clearly to all users
  • Ability to work effectively both independently and in a team environment

Preferred experience:

  • Proficiency in medical terminology and policies and prior experience in the healthcare industry is highly desirable
  • Previous infusion therapy, healthcare intake, or specialty pharmacy experience preferred
  • Previous start up experience is preferred

Location and Schedule

Location: This is a fully remote position based in the US.

Employment Type: This is a full time position working 40 hours per week. We are looking for someone who can work weekends as part of their regular schedule for this role.

Work Hours: Float operates in the PST time zone. This role is expected to work Sunday–Thursday, with shifts typically running 9am–5pm or 11am–7pm PST.

Benefits:

  • Medical, dental, vision
  • 401k matching
  • Unlimited PTO with minimum days
  • Paid parental leave
  • Home office setup
  • Phone & internet monthly stipend
  • Annual Learning Stipend
  • HSA & FSA
  • Voluntary Life, Accident, Hospital, and Critical Illness Insurance
  • 100% remote (within the US)

Compensation:

Compensation for this role consists of a base salary and options grant, with the base salary expected to range from $48,000 to $50,000. Individual compensation will be commensurate with the candidate’s experience and skills.

Culture:

We’re a Series A startup looking for individuals who are willing to grow with the team and adapt to our fast-paced, ever changing work environment.

At Float, we #WorkfortheSuperNurse. We believe that making the best nurses the heroes attracts the best talent, and in turn delivers the best patient experience. As our nurses boldly do what’s right for our patients, we boldly do what’s right for them. If this is a purpose that inspires you, we’d love to talk!

Float Health is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate the diversity of the team that builds for diverse users. We are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees.

Salary: $48,000 – $50,000 / year

jobs.description:
This position is for self-employed contract/per project work in Botswana(we would contact you when a project is available and fits your background, send you an offer to work in that specific project for a given period of time and pay you after you complete all required deliverables).

Please note all applications will need to be in English in order to be considered.

Euromonitor International is looking for a professional with a business background to support the fieldwork of our market research projects in Botswana. You will be

  • Regularly engaged on short-term ad-hoc projects (approx. 6-8 weeks per project) as we require you skill set in the region
  • remotely supported on each project by a project manager in one of our EMEAI offices.

This role will suit a self-starting and independent individual, who is looking for the flexibility of working from home. Experience within the FMCG/consumer service sectors is ideal.

As part of Euromonitor’s core methodology, our analysts gather relevant information from in-depth conversations with key industry decision makers. Success relies on researchers’ ability to proactively recruit and secure interviews with the right contacts, and their ability to uncover key data and insights via open discussions.

Being ad-hoc, our projects can address different types of questions to deliver insightful business intelligence. Examples of this include:

  • How much dairy was sold in Botswana in 2018? Why did sales increase/decline over the previous year?
  • What companies are the leading players in the consumer finance market? What share of sales is held by the leading brands?
  • What are the ideal channels for meal kits in Botswana?
  • Why is company X doing better than company Y? What strategy is being employed and how is this supported operationally?

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Conducting interviews with key players along the value chain: manufacturers, suppliers, distributors, associations, government, etc.
  • Researching contacts / networking to establish links in the industry.
  • Reviewing and collecting information from secondary sources.
  • Visiting retail stores to gather product information and speak to staff.
  • Analyzing quantitative (MS-Excel) and qualitative information.
  • Hypothesis testing.
  • Generating MS-Word and PowerPoint reports in English.
  • Availability of min. 30 hours per week when actively engaged on a project

Requirements
